%d sparks drain
DIE. Why will you not die?
(The Rings stop spinning... sink... and stitch me back together, shard by shard.)
They remember me. Even in his hands.
I forged them! They are MINE!
You forged them. But it was from me that you took them.
(in the old, gentle voice) Stay down, Bearer. I will take care of everything. As always.
No. It's not your voice that lifts me anymore.
...Why do they choose you?
Because I never caged them.
(Dark. No voice. Only the shards, warm, gathering me up off the ground.)
No one lifts me up. ...So I lift myself.
(The shards that came back stitch me together. They're in my handwriting.)
I've been torn apart before. That isn't how it ended.
Ina sang off-key. Merou carried water. Tasso read the stars.
I get up for them.
(Almost whole. The shards don't raise me out of duty.)
They raise me out of longing.
He does not stay with you. No one stays with you. Only I do.
Climb. Thrones are not won lying down.
No. No, no, no. Get UP.
Hold on to my voice and climb it. I will not lose you in some ditch of the Kenoma.
Breathe. Or whatever it is you do instead.
Again. Be still. I am holding your spark: it does not slip away from me.
Every return costs dearly. Pay in sparks, not in yourself. You are worth every one of them.
Does the body remember the fall? Let it also remember who raised it. Every time.
Get up. I need you whole.
...You. I need you. That is what I meant.
Do not die before your time. ...Before we are done. Before we are done together.
As many times as it takes, lost spark. I do not know how to give up on you. Not now.
I would remake the whole world to set you back on your feet.
...Do not look at me like that. It is a figure of speech.
(The light stitches you back together. %s from your open hand.)
(Darkness. A heart beating. Then, ash in the mouth.)
Wake. ...That is it. Slowly. I am here.
(the mask cracks) ...Ah. Your light is greater than I remembered.
Did you feel it? His seal has broken. Up above, seven thrones have just awoken.
The Aeon of Torpor. Here the dead do not know they have died; the city dreams for them.
Do not hate those who sleep. Yesterday, you slept.
I wanted to lie down too. ...I won't.
The Aeon of Hunger. These markets devour whoever buys. Everything here has a price, even longing.
I don't even know what I lost. How do I refuse whatever he offers me?
The Aeon of the Chain. The law of this place does not protect: it binds. Every seal is a padlock.
I follow a voice I can't see. Is that a chain too?
It is trust. That is different. Break the seals, and climb.
The Aeon of Silence. A library of blank books: here they silenced the truth, page by page.
Listen to what goes unsaid. That is how this place is read.
There's a voice beneath yours. Here, in the silence, I'm going to hear it.
The Aeon of the Mirror. Careful, Bearer: here, the enemy is you.
The reflection fights with your strength and your fury. The one who knows herself wins.
I want to see my face. Even if it attacks me.
The Aeon of Blight. The sparks here go out slowly, like candles in a swamp.
Despair is their last weapon. It is not yours.
I'm tired. For the first time, I say it out loud: tired.
The Aeon of the Crown. The last step. The Archon here nearly touched the Blind One's throne.
The last step. Then I find out who I am. You promised.
Athoth
Bearer... you do not sleep either, do you? I know this weariness. Lie down. I will dream the rest for you.
If you sleep now, you will never wake again. Choose.
Harmas
Your house. The window over the river. The boats you used to count. I kept it all, nice and warm. Stay.
(How does he know about the window?)
Archons steal memories. That one is ours. Do not let him. Choose.
Galila
It is recorded that you are out of place. Without law, all falls: I fell once. Kneel, and none will let you go.
A polished chain is still a chain. Choose.
Yabel
(does not speak; points to his own sewn mouth, then to yours, and offers the rest of never answering again)
His silence is a comfortable tomb. Choose.
Astaphaios
Look: it is us, before the ashes, at the window, counting boats. Stay this side of the glass. I will take the rest.
It is the cruelest blow of all. I know. Choose.
Belias
He mistakes weariness for truth. Choose.
Armupiel
The Blind One never once looked at me. Perhaps he will look at you. Take my crown. Be what I almost was.
To reign in a prison is still to be a prisoner. Choose.
He lies. Choose.
Good. Refusal is a blade too, and you are sharpening it.
...You took his bribe. The sparks weigh in your pocket. And on your soul.
I do not judge you. But remember: whatever an Archon gives, he collects.
Why wake? Out there is only the lack!
If I let go, I fall! Everyone falls!
